https://ado-dokidokihimitsukichi-daigaku.title: Venue Report! July 27 (Sat.), 28 (Sun.) Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" at Hiroshima Green Arena
text: We are pleased to present photos taken at the venue of the Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" Hiroshima Green Arena held on July 27 and 28, 2024.
The fastest report of Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" will be updated after all shows of the tour. Please be forewarned.

The staff actually checked the daytime temperatures on Saturday, July 27, which reached a high of 34°C. On Sunday, July 28, the temperature reached a high of 35°C. It was extremely hot for two days in a row. It was very hot every day. Many of our guests were wearing parasols, and the sun was especially harsh during the daytime.
Even in such a situation, many customers gathered even before the start time of merchandise sales. Thank you very much.
We expect the weather to continue to be very hot, so please take good care of your health by using parasols and drinking plenty of water.
In addition, in this performance
Costume Exhibit
Mona Lisa Profile" photo spot
is also being implemented.
We hope that everyone who comes to the exhibition will enjoy it with their own eyes.

The sun was hiding in the morning of the 27th, but the blue skies opened up and the weather was clear from the morning of the 28th. The Hiroshima Green Arena, photographed from a distance, looked like this, surrounded by nature and located in a very beautiful town.
Many people gathered from early in the morning, especially at the merchandise sales booth and the Gacha Gacha (toy machine) booth.
First of all, the merchandise sales went smoothly thanks to the numbered ticket system, and especially on the second day, the lineup seemed to be even smoother.

Many of the visitors lined up at each counter after carefully looking at the actual products on display before making their selections. We will continue to display products for sale in the future, so why don't you take a look at them before purchasing? Looking at the photos taken after the show, you can see that there were many customers who owned the "Profile of Mona Lisa" muffler towel and the "Ado's Doki Doki Secret Base" face towel ver.2. There were also a lot of T-shirts and "Too many of them? But aren't they cute? Many customers purchased penlights as necessities for the LIVE.

The Gacha Gacha booth was overflowing with customers from the start of the event. We had to move the waiting line to a shaded area to avoid the sun. We were very pleased to see the happy and sad faces of the customers as they opened the capsules of the Gacha at every venue. We hope that you will continue to line up for the Gacha Gacha experience at all of our venues in the future.

At the Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base booth, we again handed out "Ado fortune" and "special wet tissues" only available on this tour. We were impressed by the large number of children who attended this year's event. We are very happy if the participation in the "Ado lottery" together with LI VE will be a memorable part of your summer vacation.
And. There were many who came to draw lots on both days, and while they were happy to get mad on the first day, they drew a big lucky on the second day, which made them happy again.
The "Ado-mikuji" and "special wet wipes" are available once per person per day, but you can participate even if you come every day, so please come to the upcoming venues as well.
■As the opening time approached, many visitors came to the venue.

■After the show, it was impressive to see many customers with towels on their shoulders and in their hands. It was a scene that showed that they had sweated a lot at the LIVE, as well as the heat outside. I think that is how much they enjoyed the LIVE. Many people were taking commemorative photos on both days, but there were also many people standing in line to purchase goods that they could not buy before the show started.

■After the show, many people lined up to buy CDs so that they could enjoy the afterglow of the live performance at home. CD sales will be held at each venue in the future. There will also be special offers available only at the venues, so please consider purchasing a CD.
Thank you very much for the performance at Hiroshima Green Arena.

https://ado-dokidokihimitsukichi-daigaku.title: Venue Report! July 20 (Sat), 21 (Sun) Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" at Toki Messe, Niigata
text: Photos taken at the venue of the Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" held at Toki Messe, Niigata on July 20 (Sat.) and 21 (Sun.), 2024 are now available.
The fastest report of Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" will be updated after all shows of the tour. Please be forewarned.

On July 20 (Sat.), it was raining until around the time merchandise sales began, and despite the bad weather, many people came to the event. The 21st was also cloudy in the morning, but as the opening time approached, the weather became clearer and clearer.
In addition, in this performance
Costume Exhibit
Mona Lisa Profile" photo spot
is also being implemented.
We hope that everyone who comes to the exhibition will enjoy it with their own eyes.
It was raining in the morning near the venue on ◼20...
There was a beautiful blue sky at ◼️ around 15:00.
◼️21 was cloudy, but many people came to purchase goods from the morning.

◼️ We had a very large turnout at each of our booths on both days. As for merchandise sales, various fashionable "Mona Lisa Profile" T-shirts and "Ado's Doki Doki Secret Base" official T-shirts ver.3 were very popular again this year.

This time, in particular, we saw a large number of elderly customers participating and purchasing merchandise, compared to previous LIVEs. Some of them may have never purchased LIVE merchandise before, but some of the merchandise, such as T-shirts, were available for viewing at each venue. We hope that you will take a look at them and consider them before purchasing.

The ◼️ gacha gacha booth was also enjoyed by many visitors from the start to the end of the show. The Gacha Gacha booth was also a very exciting part of the two-day event, as visitors cheered every time they opened a capsule. We also saw many mothers and fathers enjoying themselves with their children at this booth, which made us all very happy.

◼️At the Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base booth, we will again be handing out "Ado-mikuji," or "special wet tissues," which are exclusive to this tour. This time, it was not easy to get a "bad luck" fortune, but we were very happy to see the customers who got a "bad luck" fortune and their friends were very excited and happy, which made us very happy together. The Secret Base booth will continue to be exhibited at various venues in the future, so please stop by and visit us.
The venue was crowded both outside and inside with many visitors every day when the doors opened.

After the show ended at ◼️, everyone was still in the excitement of the live performance and enjoyed themselves taking pictures of the exhibits and with their friends on both days. On the 21st, just after the show, the sun was shining in the west, creating a very beautiful scene. The sun was also shining on the Secret Base booth, and we were able to enjoy the beautiful scenery together with everyone.
◼️Thank you for coming to Toki Messe, Niigata, on both days of the show.

text: We are pleased to present photos taken at the venue of the Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" Osaka-jo Hall concert held on July 14 (Sun.) and 15 (Mon.), 2024 (national holiday).
The fastest report of Ado JAPAN TOUR 2024 "Profile of Mona Lisa" will be updated after all shows of the tour. Please be forewarned.

◼On July 14 (Sunday) and 15 (Monday, national holiday), we had a great turnout for the start of the tour on both days. The forecast in advance for both days was rain. Although it rained a little, it did not affect the start of merchandise sales and the opening of the venue and the show. Last year, for "Mars," the rain at Osaka-jo Hall mysteriously stopped before and after the show. We could not help but feel the power of the audience at the same venue this time as well.
In addition, in this performance
Costume Exhibit
Mona Lisa Profile" photo spot
is also being implemented.
We hope that everyone who comes to the exhibition will enjoy it with their own eyes.

◼ A very large number of visitors attended the event at each booth on both days. For merchandise sales, various fashionable "Mona Lisa Profile" T-shirts and "Ado's Doki Doki Secret Base" official T-shirts ver.3 were very popular, and we saw many customers purchasing and wearing them. Many of the audience members were seen purchasing and wearing these T-shirts, which were sold at past shows such as "Mars" and "Mirage".

Penlights were also purchased by many visitors, as they have become very popular as a must-have item for live performances. Many people also purchased Adochan straps, which are designed differently at each venue.

Once again, we have introduced QR code numbered tickets so that visitors can purchase merchandise with as little waiting time as possible. We will continue to announce the sales of merchandise at each venue, as well as the waiting lines for merchandise and QR code lines, on "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" and other sites.

The ◼️ Gacha Gacha booth was enjoyed by many visitors from the beginning to the end of the show. Many of them were seen spinning the gacha-gacha with their families and friends, and many of them were bursting with joy when they got the item they were looking for.

At the ◼Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base booth, we again handed out "Ado-mikuji" and this time, "special wet tissues". Many visitors drew the lottery again this year, hoping to get a "crazy (bad) luck. After drawing the lottery, many customers took selfies with the lottery and wet wipes. The Secret Base booth will be exhibited at each venue again this year. Please use the wet wipes after you get excited and sweaty from the raffle.

text: Ado's new song "Lulu" has been chosen as the theme song for Fuji Television's Friday 9:00 p.m. drama "Billion X School" (airs every Friday from 21:00 to 21:58). Lulu" is a song by Vocaloid P, MARETU, and is about rebelling against the rules of the world, which are full of contradictions. The thick and hard melody, combined with Ado's singing that changes gears in multiple personalities, creates a theme song that matches the worldview of the drama, which is about "breaking the rules of the world. The song's jacket has also been unveiled and is illustrated by artist Ichi (read: Ninomae). It has also been decided that the soundtrack will be distributed at 10:15 p.m. on July 5 (Fri.), after the first broadcast of the drama (first broadcast only, from 21:00-22:13).

Ryosuke Yamada stars in Fuji Television's Friday 9 drama "Billion X School," a school comedy in which the main character, a billionaire and head of Japan's largest conglomerate, hides his identity to become a school teacher and grows with his students while facing a variety of problems. The film is a school comedy that depicts the protagonist, a "billionaire" who hides his identity to become a school teacher and grows with his students while facing various problems. A new homeroom teacher arrives at Eto Academy, a private school where students with "zero motivation, zero talent, and zero potential" are gathered. The new homeroom teacher is Kagami Rei (Yamada Ryosuke), a good-looking but somewhat peculiar teacher, who is assigned to the bottom class, commonly known as "class zero" and looked down upon. He is a teacher whose assets and energy are "off the charts" and who is completely unacceptable to the school's common sense. In reality, he is the CEO of a major Japanese conglomerate and a "billionaire.

Times change, but the root of the problems faced by adolescents remain the same. And yet, the educational field is changing. We must not get angry, we must not force something, we must not call them out, we must not overstep into the student's shoes.... In this age of AI, do we really need teachers? A new hero, a "new school leader," will emerge to destroy such common sense!

Kagami has perfect looks, perfect brains, and perfect management skills. How does this perfect Kagami face the problems of today's children in a class that seems to be a condensation of all the problems of today's children? And what will the students learn from Kagami? This is where the unknown interaction between Kagami and the "Zero Class"="the top teacher of a winning family and the bottom class of a losing family" begins! Please look forward to the drama "Billion X School" starring Ryosuke Yamada, which is sure to make you laugh, cry, and be moved by the unpredictable chemistry between Kagami and his students! The chime for the start of the "Billionaire Billionaire" teaching - the chime for the start of the school year is now sounding!
I hope you are looking forward to the drama and the theme song.

I am pleased to announce that I will be in charge of the theme song for "BILLION X SCHOOL". The theme song "Lulu" was composed by MARETU.
